mobbin:376a68ad-85c8-4071-a09d-bbfe73ce7.summary: The user starts a Life Score test from 0/150, answers radio and multi-select items plus a frequency slider, then reviews a scored Weekly insights breakdown with retake.
steps: Life Score hub: 0/150 and Take the test
Strength slider at 41/41 progress, mid value
Strength slider value 2-3 h / week and NEXT
Current status: OPTIMAL and GREAT groups
Lower statuses: OFF-TRACK and Retake the test
steal: NEXT stays disabled until a choice is made (screens 2 and 4), so rubric items must be completed.
Large full-row radio and multi-check targets (screens 2 to 5) suit one-hand, gloved scoring.
A continuous slider with a live value label for graded items (screens 6 to 7) is a partial-credit analog.
After submit, a score gauge and grouped status cards from OPTIMAL to OFF-TRACK (screens 8 to 11) support review after fill.
avoid: A 41-step path for live scoring is too slow during a sim (screen 6). Keep rubrics short or sectioned.
mobbin:376a68ad-85c8-4071-a09d-bbfe73ce7.fit: Mobile and iPad app: one question at a time beats desktop forms for faculty filling a rubric live. Extends baseline checklist with large targets and a scored summary. Compress length for exam constraints.
